$comment: Source of truth for the OLOID docs navigation.
Each group carries `collections`: the Intercom collections whose articles
land there, keyed 'Product :: Collection'. Groups nest (Windows > Windows
Login > V1), and each nested group is a directory inside its parent's.
`match` places articles by title: `titles` are regexes, tried in this
file's order before any collection mapping, against articles from
_Unassigned plus the collections listed in `from` ('*' = any collection).
The first match wins, so product-specific groups sit above the generic
portal ones. Every title placement is listed in the --migrate report.
A group with slug 'videos' receives every video-only article from the
groups beneath its parent (nearest one wins).
`excluded_collections` have no place in the main navigation. They are still
fetched and written, to Drafts > Excluded, are never placed by a title rule,
and are tagged 'excluded' in the report and the manifest. A group with
`"catch_unmapped": true` receives articles whose collection no group claims.
Getting Started guides are planned in plans/getting-started.md.
build_nav.py turns this into docs.json. Edit this file, never docs.json.
